verdict.rationale: Typesense is an API-first search engine. Its docs say the complete API surface ships in the open-source server [docs-61], and it publishes versioned API reference pages such as the curation endpoint docs [docs-45]. It advertises Full API Access [docs-56], walks through collection creation, indexing and search via the API [docs-8], and an independent user describes it as Lucene's feature set plus a REST interface [comm-3]; an llms.txt for agents [probe-1] and a Cloud MCP server [docs-43] add agent-friendly access on top. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the probed paths [probe-3], and endpoint-level reference detail is thin in the pack.
